# Bun bun-v1.4.2

> Documentation generated from the latest stable release of [oven-sh/bun](https://github.com/oven-sh/bun) and pinned to immutable source commit `744846f844374847c902b5e7fd59b4342a51ef99`.

- [Full documentation](llms-full.txt): Complete normalized corpus for Bun bun-v1.4.2.
- [Provenance manifest](manifest.json): Release, commit, document count, and generation notes.
- Pages and their order come from the release-tagged Mintlify navigation in docs/docs.json; unreferenced files are excluded and snippets are inlined rather than published as duplicate pages.
- Static MDX cards, tabs, accordions, steps, callouts, and media frames are normalized to Markdown without executing JavaScript.
- Published page links resolve to https://bun.com/docs; source assets point at the immutable release commit.

## Get Started

- [TypeScript 6 and 7](pages/typescript-6.md): TypeScript 6.0 changed how it discovers type definitions. If you've upgraded TypeScript and your editor no longer recognizes Bun, Request, or other globals from @types/bun, here's how to fix it. (2257 bytes)

## Interop & Tooling

## Contributing

- [Roadmap](pages/project/roadmap.md): Bun is a project with a large scope and is still in its early days. Long-term, Bun aims to provide an all-in-one toolkit to replace the complex, fragmented toolchains common today: Node.js, Jest, Webpack, esbuild, Babel… (383 bytes)
- [Benchmarking](pages/project/benchmarking.md): Bun is designed for speed. We profile and benchmark hot paths extensively. The source code for all of Bun's public benchmarks is in the /bench directory of the Bun repo. (10626 bytes)
- [Contributing](pages/project/contributing.md): Configuring a development environment for Bun can take 10-30 minutes depending on your internet connection and computer speed. You will need \10GB of free disk space for the repository and build artifacts. (16795 bytes)
- [Building Windows](pages/project/building-windows.md): Use PowerShell 7 (pwsh.exe) instead of the default powershell.exe. If you run into problems, ask in the #contributing channel on our Discord. (7883 bytes)
- [Bindgen](pages/project/bindgen.md): The bindings generator scans for .bind.ts files to find function and class definitions, and generates glue code to interop between JavaScript and native code. (8075 bytes)
- [License](pages/project/license.md): Bun itself is MIT-licensed. (10787 bytes)

- [bun prune](pages/pm/cli/prune.md): bun prune deletes everything in nodemodules that the current bun.lock would not install: packages left behind after switching branches, removing a dependency, or installing with another package manager. With the isolate… (3271 bytes)

## Binary Data

- [Convert an ArrayBuffer to a string](pages/guides/binary/arraybuffer-to-string.md): Bun implements the Web-standard TextDecoder class for converting between binary data types and strings. (398 bytes)
- [Convert an ArrayBuffer to a Buffer](pages/guides/binary/arraybuffer-to-buffer.md): The Node.js Buffer API predates the introduction of ArrayBuffer into the JavaScript language. Bun implements both. (698 bytes)
- [Convert an ArrayBuffer to a Blob](pages/guides/binary/arraybuffer-to-blob.md): You can construct a Blob from an array of "chunks", where each chunk is a string, binary data structure, or another Blob. (620 bytes)
- [Convert an ArrayBuffer to an array of numbers](pages/guides/binary/arraybuffer-to-array.md): To retrieve the contents of an ArrayBuffer as an array of numbers, create a Uint8Array over the buffer, then use Array.from() to convert it to an array. (941 bytes)
- [Convert an ArrayBuffer to a Uint8Array](pages/guides/binary/arraybuffer-to-typedarray.md): A Uint8Array is a typed array, a view over the data in an underlying ArrayBuffer. (912 bytes)
- [Convert a Buffer to a string](pages/guides/binary/buffer-to-string.md): The Buffer class provides a .toString() method that converts a Buffer to a string. (491 bytes)
- [Convert a Buffer to an ArrayBuffer](pages/guides/binary/buffer-to-arraybuffer.md): The Node.js Buffer class views and manipulates data in an underlying ArrayBuffer. The buffer property returns that ArrayBuffer. (366 bytes)
- [Convert a Buffer to a blob](pages/guides/binary/buffer-to-blob.md): You can construct a Blob from an array of "chunks", where each chunk is a string, binary data structure (including Buffer), or another Blob. (387 bytes)
- [Convert a Buffer to a Uint8Array](pages/guides/binary/buffer-to-typedarray.md): The Node.js Buffer class extends Uint8Array, so no conversion is needed. All properties and methods on Uint8Array are available on Buffer. (473 bytes)
- [Convert a Buffer to a ReadableStream](pages/guides/binary/buffer-to-readablestream.md): The naive approach to creating a ReadableStream from a Buffer is to use the ReadableStream constructor and enqueue the entire array as a single chunk. For a large buffer, this approach may be undesirable because it does… (1188 bytes)
- [Convert a Blob to a string](pages/guides/binary/blob-to-string.md): The Blob class provides several methods for consuming its contents in different formats, including .text(). (379 bytes)
- [Convert a Blob to an ArrayBuffer](pages/guides/binary/blob-to-arraybuffer.md): The Blob class provides several methods for consuming its contents in different formats, including .arrayBuffer(). (379 bytes)
- [Convert a Blob to a Uint8Array](pages/guides/binary/blob-to-typedarray.md): The Blob class provides several methods for consuming its contents in different formats. Use .bytes() to read the contents as a Uint8Array. (626 bytes)
- [Convert a Blob to a DataView](pages/guides/binary/blob-to-dataview.md): The Blob class provides several methods for consuming its contents in different formats. Read the contents into an ArrayBuffer with .arrayBuffer(), then create a DataView from the buffer. (466 bytes)
- [Convert a Blob to a ReadableStream](pages/guides/binary/blob-to-stream.md): The Blob class provides several methods for consuming its contents in different formats, including .stream(), which returns a ReadableStream. (402 bytes)
- [Convert a Uint8Array to a string](pages/guides/binary/typedarray-to-string.md): Bun implements the Web-standard TextDecoder class for converting binary data types like Uint8Array to strings. (441 bytes)
- [Convert a Uint8Array to an ArrayBuffer](pages/guides/binary/typedarray-to-arraybuffer.md): A Uint8Array is a typed array, a view over data in an underlying ArrayBuffer. The buffer property returns that ArrayBuffer. (809 bytes)
- [Convert a Uint8Array to a Buffer](pages/guides/binary/typedarray-to-buffer.md): The Buffer class extends Uint8Array with additional methods. Use Buffer.from() to create a Buffer instance from a Uint8Array. (452 bytes)
- [Convert a Uint8Array to a Blob](pages/guides/binary/typedarray-to-blob.md): You can construct a Blob from an array of "chunks", where each chunk is a string, binary data structure (including Uint8Array), or another Blob. (467 bytes)
- [Convert a Uint8Array to a DataView](pages/guides/binary/typedarray-to-dataview.md): A Uint8Array is a typed array, a view over data in an underlying ArrayBuffer. To convert it to a DataView, create one over the same range of data. (474 bytes)
- [Convert a Uint8Array to a ReadableStream](pages/guides/binary/typedarray-to-readablestream.md): The naive approach to creating a ReadableStream from a Uint8Array is to use the ReadableStream constructor and enqueue the entire array as a single chunk. For a large array, this approach may be undesirable because it d… (1299 bytes)
- [Convert a DataView to a string](pages/guides/binary/dataview-to-string.md): If a DataView contains ASCII-encoded text, use the TextDecoder class to convert it to a string. (473 bytes)

## Streams

- [Convert a ReadableStream to a string](pages/guides/streams/to-string.md): Bun provides several conveniences for reading the contents of a ReadableStream into other formats. To read a stream into a string, call its text() method. (571 bytes)
- [Convert a ReadableStream to JSON](pages/guides/streams/to-json.md): Bun provides several conveniences for reading the contents of a ReadableStream into other formats. To read a stream and parse it as JSON, call its json() method. (471 bytes)
- [Convert a ReadableStream to a Blob](pages/guides/streams/to-blob.md): Bun provides several conveniences for reading the contents of a ReadableStream into other formats. To read a stream into a Blob, call its blob() method. (570 bytes)
- [Convert a ReadableStream to a Buffer](pages/guides/streams/to-buffer.md): To convert a ReadableStream to a Buffer, read its contents into an ArrayBuffer with Bun.readableStreamToArrayBuffer, then create a Buffer that points to it. (675 bytes)
- [Convert a ReadableStream to an ArrayBuffer](pages/guides/streams/to-arraybuffer.md): Bun.readableStreamToArrayBuffer reads the contents of a ReadableStream into an ArrayBuffer. (438 bytes)
- [Convert a ReadableStream to a Uint8Array](pages/guides/streams/to-typedarray.md): To convert a ReadableStream to a Uint8Array, read its contents into an ArrayBuffer with Bun.readableStreamToArrayBuffer, then create a Uint8Array that points to the buffer. (1005 bytes)
- [Convert a ReadableStream to an array of chunks](pages/guides/streams/to-array.md): Bun.readableStreamToArray reads the contents of a ReadableStream into an array of chunks. (435 bytes)
- [Convert a Node.js Readable to a string](pages/guides/streams/node-readable-to-string.md): To convert a Node.js Readable stream to a string in Bun, create a Response with the stream as the body, then call response.text(). (500 bytes)
- [Convert a Node.js Readable to JSON](pages/guides/streams/node-readable-to-json.md): To convert a Node.js Readable stream to a JSON object in Bun, create a Response with the stream as the body, then call response.json(). (510 bytes)
- [Convert a Node.js Readable to a Blob](pages/guides/streams/node-readable-to-blob.md): To convert a Node.js Readable stream to a Blob in Bun, create a Response with the stream as the body, then call response.blob(). (508 bytes)
- [Convert a Node.js Readable to an Uint8Array](pages/guides/streams/node-readable-to-uint8array.md): To convert a Node.js Readable stream to a Uint8Array in Bun, create a Response with the stream as the body, then call bytes(). (329 bytes)
- [Convert a Node.js Readable to an ArrayBuffer](pages/guides/streams/node-readable-to-arraybuffer.md): To convert a Node.js Readable stream to an ArrayBuffer in Bun, create a Response with the stream as the body, then call arrayBuffer(). (344 bytes)
